user.title: Set up Marstek Venus
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Marstek Venus battery. Enable the Open API first in the Marstek app.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the device. Check the IP address and that the Open API is enabled in the Marstek app.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Make sure the device is powered on and reachable on your network.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

data_description.timeout: How long to wait for a device response. Increase if sensors go unavailable frequently (default: 10 s).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the device (default: 30 s).
